/corecraft/garden-decor/deluxe-swing.htm.description: Deluxe Swing is a two-seater garden swing with a canopy overhead and a steel frame, made for lawns, terraces and clubhouse gardens. In the photo it carries a red canopy that shades the seat, so residents can sit out even in the afternoon. This is garden furniture for adults and families, and it belongs in housing society gardens, resort lawns and the quieter corners of a campus. We fabricate it at our Vasai factory and can adjust the design to match your landscape plan. Tell us where it will stand and we will suggest whether it should be self-standing or grouted.
/corecraft/garden-decor/deluxe-swing.htm.name: Deluxe Swing

/corecraft/garden-decor/dna-pergola.html.description: The DNA Pergola is a walk-through garden pergola with a wavy roof of wooden slats carried on a dark steel frame. Its curving profile gives a long garden path or a society entrance walkway a covered stretch that people remember. Landscape architects can use it to link a gate to a clubhouse, or to frame part of a jogging track in a park. Because the roof follows a wave pattern, it looks different from the front and from the side, which keeps a long run interesting. Length and layout can be customised to your site. Share a site plan and photos, and our design team will propose an arrangement.
/corecraft/garden-decor/dna-pergola.html.name: DNA Pergola

/corecraft/garden-decor/eco-bench.html.description: Eco Bench is a simple park bench with wooden slats for the seat and backrest, set on black steel legs. Choose it when you need many seats along a walking track, around a play area or in a school courtyard, and want them all to look alike. Parents watching children on the swings need somewhere to sit, and a row of Eco Benches at the edge of the safe play area gives them that. We make our garden furniture in-house at Vasai East and send it by road to sites across India. Call +91 902 830 2266 with the number of benches you need.
/corecraft/garden-decor/eco-bench.html.name: Eco Bench

/corecraft/garden-decor/grin-barrel-bin..description: Grin Barrel Bin is an outdoor dustbin shaped like a wooden barrel and mounted on a bright yellow stand. A bin that looks like part of the garden tends to get used, and this one sits comfortably beside benches, gazebos and playground entrances. Housing societies, municipal parks, resorts and school campuses can place them along paths and near seating. The stand lifts the barrel clear of the ground, which helps during the monsoon. It belongs to our CoreCraft Garden Decor range, so you can order matching benches and pergolas with it. Write to sales@funplaysystems.com with the number of bins you need.
/corecraft/garden-decor/grin-barrel-bin..name: Grin Barrel Bin

/corecraft/garden-decor/luxury-swing.htm.description: Luxury Swing is a garden swing bench hung from a steel A-frame, with a red canopy shading the people on it. The bench seat makes it a comfortable choice for elderly residents and for couples who want a gentle swing in the evening. Place one on a society lawn, a resort garden, a farmhouse or the senior citizens' corner of a park. Before you decide, compare it with our Deluxe Swing, a two-seater that also has a canopy. Our team will advise whether self-standing or grouted installation suits your ground. Ask us for a quote and a delivery plan.
/corecraft/garden-decor/luxury-swing.htm.name: Luxury Swing

/corecraft/garden-decor/maestro-bench.ht.description: Maestro Bench pairs a wooden-slat seat and backrest with decorative curved armrests in black. Armrests help older users sit down and get up, and the curves give a formal garden a finished look. It suits clubhouse lawns, hotel gardens, corporate campuses and the entrance courts of residential towers. If you are planning a mix of seating, use Maestro at the key spots and simpler benches along the paths. We can customise the design to your landscape scheme. Send us your landscape drawing and we will mark where the benches could go.
/corecraft/garden-decor/maestro-bench.ht.name: Maestro Bench

/corecraft/garden-decor/pyramid-pergola..description: Pyramid Pergola is a wooden garden pergola with a pyramid-shaped roof and coloured panels. A walkway pergola covers a path, whereas this one creates a single shaded spot that can become a meeting point on a lawn or a sit-out beside a pool. Put benches under it on a society lawn, or use it as a waiting area near a resort reception. The panel colours can be changed to suit your theme, because we customise designs to client requirement. Tell us the space you have, along with a few photos, and we will check the fit.
/corecraft/garden-decor/pyramid-pergola..name: Pyramid Pergola

/corecraft/garden-decor/relaxed-bench.ht.description: Relaxed Bench is an outdoor seat with wooden slats on a black steel frame, for gardens, parks and open spaces. Its plain lines suit modern buildings, IT campuses and new residential projects where the landscape is kept clean and simple. Builders often want seating that can stand beside play equipment and outdoor gym stations without clashing, and this bench does that. We fabricate our frames in-house and inspect each piece at Vasai before dispatch. Ask for a layout drawing that shows benches, play equipment and walkways together.
/corecraft/garden-decor/relaxed-bench.ht.name: Relaxed Bench

/corecraft/garden-decor/repose-gazebo.ht.description: Repose Gazebo is a wooden garden gazebo with a pyramid roof and a railing around the sides. It gives a society or resort a covered sit-out where people can talk, read or wait out a passing shower. Place it near a children's play area and parents get a shaded spot to watch from. For a hotel or farmhouse, it works as an outdoor seating point for guests. A gazebo has a fixed footprint, so please share your site size and photos first. We will suggest a position and the installation method that suits the ground.
/corecraft/garden-decor/repose-gazebo.ht.name: Repose Gazebo

/corecraft/garden-decor/stand-out-bench..description: With its angular black steel frame, the Stand Out Bench brings a sharper, more modern shape to outdoor seating. The seat and backrest are wooden slats, which keep it pleasant to sit on in hot weather. Architects working on contemporary campuses, office parks and premium housing projects can treat it as a design element as much as a seat. It also works along promenades and in plazas, where a bench is seen from every side. Like the rest of our Garden Decor range, it is made in our own factory at Vasai East. Call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 to discuss quantities.
/corecraft/garden-decor/stand-out-bench..name: Stand Out Bench

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Igloo Climber is a dome-shaped rope net climber with hanging seats, part of our CoreCraft range of individual play equipment. Children climb up the curved net, rest in a seat and then climb down again, which builds grip, balance and confidence. The dome measures 12'11" x 12'11", and you should plan a safe play area of 17'11" x 17'11" around it. Because it is round and open on every side, several children can use it together without queuing. It suits school playgrounds, society parks and resort play zones. Send us your site photos and we will place it on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Igloo Climber
facts_used: rope net dome with hanging seats (photo)

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Abstract Climber is a freestanding climbing wall faced with multi-colour abstract panels. It takes up only 5'8" x 9'4", with a safe play area of 10'8" x 14'4", so it fits on a school ground or society play area where space is short. Children find their own route up the panels, which keeps the wall interesting long after the first climb. The bright colours also give a new playground a strong focal point. Pair it with a slide or a see saw so that younger children have something to do nearby. Ask us for a layout that shows the wall and its safe area.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Abstract Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Our Balancing Beam is a set of three low beams in teal, yellow and red for children learning to balance. Walking along a narrow beam close to the ground trains balance and focus without the height of a climber. The set covers 2'9" x 12'11" and needs a safe play area of 7'9" x 17'11". That long, narrow strip can run along the edge of a playground or beside a garden path. Preschools and primary schools can use it in PE periods as well as at break time. We will add it to your layout drawing once you share the site size.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Balancing Beam
facts_used: three low beams in teal, yellow and red (photo)

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Balancing Bridge is a suspended bridge with colourful stepping pads, finished in Play Orange and Knight Blue. As children step from pad to pad, the bridge moves under their feet, so they learn to shift their weight and keep their footing. It is 24'2" long and 2'11" wide, and needs a safe play area of 29'2" x 7'11". That long shape is useful for linking two parts of a play area, or for filling a narrow strip beside a boundary wall in a school or society. Share your site measurements and we will check whether it fits.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Balancing Bridge

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Crawling Tunnel is a crawl-through play tunnel in Play Orange and Baby Blue. Small children like going in at one end and coming out at the other, and crawling builds strength in the arms and shoulders. The tunnel covers 8'10" x 4'6", with a safe play area of 13'10" x 9'6". It sits low to the ground, which makes it a sensible choice for preschools, day-care centres and the toddler corner of a society park. Teachers can also build it into obstacle games during play time. Call +91 902 830 2266 to add it to your playground order.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Crawling Tunnel

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Crest Climber is an overhead ladder climber in Play Red and Play Yellow, with a ladder at each end. Children climb up one side, swing hand over hand along the rungs and come down the other. That simple sequence builds upper-body strength and a firm grip. The frame covers 10'10" x 4'8" and needs a safe play area of 15'10" x 7'8". For a school that wants a classic monkey bar station, it is a straightforward option, and it sits well next to a multi play system. We make it at our Vasai factory and can dispatch it with the rest of your equipment.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Crest Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Disc Challanger is a stepping challenge made of hanging discs on a steel frame. Each disc swings a little as a child steps onto it, so crossing from one end to the other takes balance, timing and concentration. The frame covers 6'6" x 3', with a safe play area of 11'6" x 8', which is compact enough for a small society play area. Children who find standard climbers easy get a fresh test here. It comes in multiple colours. Tell us the space available and we will suggest where it fits alongside your other equipment.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Disc Challanger

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Droopy Climber is an overhead ladder in Horizon Teal, with side ladders and a bird figure on the frame. The bird gives it a friendly character that suits nursery and primary school grounds. It is long and narrow, covering 11'2" x 3' with a safe play area of 16'2" x 8', so it can stand along a boundary wall without eating into open ground. Hanging from the rungs and moving along them builds grip and arm strength. Our installation team or a local dealer can set it up for you. Send us a photo of the spot you have in mind.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Droopy Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Hopping Pod is a set of colourful stepping pods on posts, made for hopping and stepping play. Children jump or step from one pod to the next, which develops balance, leg strength and coordination. The set needs only 7' x 1' of ground, with a safe play area of 12' x 6'. Such a small footprint lets it go into a crowded school ground or a corner of a society garden. Put it next to a balancing beam to make a short obstacle route. Write to sales@funplaysystems.com for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Hopping Pod

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Jumping Jacks is a set of spring-mounted bounce pads in assorted colours. A child stands on a pad and bounces, and the spring underneath adds movement that turns plain jumping into a game. The set covers 9'4" x 4' and needs a safe play area of 14'4" x 9'. It fits preschools, kindergartens and society play areas, where children enjoy something they can use over and over. Springs carry our 1-year warranty on springs, bearings and spare parts against manufacturing defects. Call +91 902 830 2266 and we will add it to your proposal.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Jumping Jacks

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Leo Climber is a yellow rope net climbing tunnel shaped like a caterpillar, in Play Yellow. Children crawl and climb through the net sections, which works the arms, legs and core together. The caterpillar shape also gives a play area a character that children recognise from a distance. It suits parks, resorts and school grounds that want a piece to explore rather than simply climb. We design and fabricate it in-house at Vasai. Please ask us for the confirmed product area and safe play area before you plan your site, and we will mark both on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Leo Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Loop Climber is a monkey bar climber with yellow rings overhead and a ladder on each side, in Play Yellow and Lavender. Swinging from ring to ring calls for a firm grip and steady arm strength. It covers 10'10" x 4'8" and needs a safe play area of 15'10" x 7'8". Primary schools and society playgrounds can use it to give older children something more demanding than a slide. Depending on your ground, we will either grout it or install it self-standing. Ask us for a layout drawing with the safe area marked.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Loop Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Monkey Climber is the familiar monkey bar, with yellow rungs between two side ladders and colours of Play Yellow and New Black. Kids climb up, cross hand over hand and drop down the far ladder, and they will do it again and again. The footprint is 3'3" x 11'6", with a safe play area of 8'3" x 16'6". It is a dependable choice for schools and municipal parks that want a proven piece of play equipment. FunPlay has been making playground equipment since 2002. Get in touch with our sales team for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Monkey Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Mushroom Climber is an arched overhead ladder in Play Red and Play Yellow, topped with a bird figure. The arch means children work their way up to the highest point and then down the other side. It covers 13'6" x 1'6" and needs a safe play area of 18'6" x 6'6", a slim footprint that fits along a path or a boundary. The cheerful colours and the bird appeal to preschool and primary school children. Our layout drawing will show exactly how it sits with your other pieces. Send us your site size to begin.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Mushroom Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Net Rock Climber is an A-frame climber with a green rock wall on one face and a rope net on the other, in Lavender. Children can go up the rock holds and come down the net, or the other way round, so two kinds of climbing share one compact frame. It covers 5'3" x 4'7", with a safe play area of 10'3" x 9'7". That makes it a good pick for a small society garden or a school with limited ground. We supply it to every region of India through our dealers. Ask us for a quote and a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Net Rock Climber
facts_used: rock wall and rope net A-frame (photo)

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Orbit Climber is a dome-shaped spider web rope climber in Ocean Grey. Children can climb onto the web from any side, so a group can play at the same time. The dome covers 10'4" x 10'4", and the safe play area is 15'4" x 15'4". Compared with our Igloo Climber, it has no hanging seats and a smaller footprint, which helps in tighter spaces. The grey tone also blends with the modern landscaping of premium housing projects. Call +91 902 830 2266 to discuss your site.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Orbit Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: S Bridge Climber is an S-shaped red overhead ladder on yellow poles, with ladders at both ends. The ladder changes direction as children move along it, so it holds their interest longer than a straight run of rungs. It covers 13' x 7'5" and needs a safe play area of 18' x 12'5". Schools, parks and society play areas can use it as a climbing station for children who have mastered the basics. Share photos of your ground and we will recommend self-standing or grouted installation.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: S Bridge Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Straight Net Climber is a vertical rope net climbing frame in New Black and Horizon Teal. Climbing a net that gives under hands and feet teaches children to shift their weight and hold on firmly. Being a simple upright frame, it can fill a gap between larger pieces or stand beside a multi play system. Schools and housing societies use nets like this to add a climbing activity at modest cost to their space. Ask us to confirm the product area and safe play area for your layout, and we will mark them on the drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Straight Net Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Tornado Climber is a long rope net climbing course in Horizon Teal, with tunnels, wave sections and a slide. It is a large piece, covering 54' x 18'10" with a safe play area of 59' x 23'10". With that much ground needed, it works in municipal parks, township play areas, resorts and big school campuses. Children crawl, climb and slide in one continuous run, and a whole class can be on it together. Ask for a layout drawing early, because the safe area will shape the rest of your plan.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Tornado Climber

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: This Trampoline is a round, in-ground trampoline with a dark teal surround, in the colour Mineral. Because the bed sits at ground level, children step straight on and off it without climbing up. It covers 5' x 5' and needs a safe play area of 11' x 11'. Jumping builds leg strength and coordination, and it brings a burst of activity to a preschool or society play area in very little space. As it is set into the ground, tell us about your soil and surface when you contact us, and we will plan the installation.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Trampoline

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Wall Rock Climber is a green freestanding rock climbing wall with holds in many colours. Children choose their holds and plan a route to the top, which builds problem-solving along with grip and leg strength. A freestanding wall needs no building to fix it to, so it can go in the middle of a play area. It suits schools, adventure zones at resorts and society play areas. Please ask us to confirm the footprint and safe play area for your site before you finalise the layout.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Wall Rock Climber
facts_used: freestanding rock wall with multi-colour holds (photo)

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Wheel Thrill Climber is an A-frame climber that combines hanging rings, a rope net and spinning wheels on one frame. Children can hang from the rings, scramble up the net or turn the wheels, so there is always something to do while others wait. It covers 11'1" x 4'7", with a safe play area of 16'1" x 9'7". All that variety makes it a sensible single piece for a society with room for only one or two items. Tell us your preferred colours when you ask for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.name: Wheel Thrill Climber
facts_used: rings, rope net and spinning wheels (photo)

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Animal Merry-Go-Round is a spinning platform with colourful bird-shaped seats for four children. It is meant for children aged 3 and above, with 3 to 6 year olds as the main users. The round unit has a diameter of 6'2", and you need a clear circle of 12'2" around it for safe play. Small children feel secure sitting in a shaped seat while the platform turns, and the bird designs appeal to nursery and kindergarten groups. Send us your site size and the age group you serve, and we will suggest a position.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Animal Merry-Go-Round

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Bucket Spinner Merry-Go-Round is a single-seat spinner, with a light blue bucket seat on a tilted red post. One child sits inside and spins, which gives a gentle sense of motion and helps develop balance. It is for children aged 3 and above, mainly 3 to 6 year olds, and the seat colour is Baby Blue. Because it takes one child at a time, it works best as an extra piece beside a larger merry-go-round or a multi play system in a preschool or society park. When you request a layout drawing, we will mark the clear space it needs.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Bucket Spinner Merry-Go-Round

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Cage Spinner puts an orange seat inside a Lavender steel basket, so the child is surrounded on all sides while it turns. That enclosed design gives young riders a little more security on a spinning ride. It takes one child at a time and suits ages 3 and above, with 3 to 6 year olds as its key users. Preschools, day-care centres and housing society toddler zones are the natural places for it. You can group it with spring riders and a low slide to make a compact under-six corner. Our team will mark its clear area on your layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Cage Spinner

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Flower Spinner is a single-seat spinner shaped like a flower, in Royal Turquoise. Children aged 3 and above, and especially those between 3 and 6, sit in it and turn round and round. The flower shape fits garden-themed playgrounds and nature-themed school grounds, and the turquoise stands out well against a green lawn. It seats one child, so a busy play area may want two or three placed together. Call +91 902 830 2266 and tell us how many you need.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Flower Spinner

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Four Seater Merry-Go-Round is a classic roundabout with red and yellow seats for four children aged 3 and above. Its main users are 3 to 9 year olds, which covers nursery right through primary school. The unit has a diameter of 6'5" and needs a safe play circle of 12'5". Children take turns to sit and push, which builds teamwork and patience. It suits schools, society parks and municipal playgrounds that need one sturdy piece for a wide age range. Ask for a quote and we will include it in a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Four Seater Merry-Go-Round

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Horse Merry-Go-Round has colourful horse seats on a round platform for up to three young riders. It is designed for children aged 3 and above, mainly in the 3 to 6 range. With a 4' diameter and a 10' safe play circle, it needs less room than our four-seat models. The horse seats give preschool children a fairground feel in their own school or society play area. It is made at our factory in Vasai East and sent to you by road. Tell us your site size and we will check whether it fits.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Horse Merry-Go-Round

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Jumbo Four Seater Merry-Go-Round has four colourful elephant-shaped seats around a turning platform. It carries four children at once, aged 3 and above, with 3 to 9 year olds as the key group. The diameter is 6'8", and the safe play area is a 12'8" circle. Elephant seats suit theme-based playgrounds at resorts and amusement areas as much as school grounds. Ask us to add it to your proposal, along with matching see saws or spring riders.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Jumbo Four Seater Merry-Go-Round

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Laminate Standing Merry-Go-Round is a yellow standing platform with a steering wheel at the centre, in Play Yellow and Knight Blue. Children stand on the platform and hold the wheel as it turns, which works their balance harder than a seated ride. It is for ages 5 and above, mainly 5 to 10 year olds, and takes four children. The platform is 4' x 4', with a safe play area of 10' x 10'. Primary schools and society parks with older children will get the most use from it. Our 3-year warranty covers composite laminate parts against manufacturing defects. Ask us for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Laminate Standing Merry-Go-Round

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Roto Platform Merry-Go-Round is a rotating platform in Sea Green with Play Yellow hand rails. Four to six children aged 5 and above can ride together, and 5 to 10 year olds are its main group. It sits on a 4' x 4' base and needs a safe play area of 10' x 10'. The hand rails give each child something to hold as the platform turns. Carrying up to six riders in a small footprint, it suits busy school playgrounds and township parks. Write to sales@funplaysystems.com with your site details.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Roto Platform Merry-Go-Round

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Roto Seating Merry-Go-Round is a rotating seat unit with a yellow seat under a steel canopy frame, for three children at a time. It is made for ages 5 and above, and its key users are 5 to 10 year olds. The unit takes 4' x 4' and needs a safe play area of 10' x 10'. A seated ride suits children who prefer a calmer turn than a standing platform gives. Societies and schools can place it beside a standing merry-go-round so that every child has a choice. Share your site photos and we will send a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Roto Seating Merry-Go-Round

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Roto Wheel Go Round Merry-Go-Round has pink and blue seats arranged around an orange steering wheel. The wheel gives children something to grip and turn as they ride. Four children aged 3 and above can use it at once, and it is aimed at 3 to 9 year olds. It takes 4' x 4' of ground and needs a safe play area of 10' x 10'. Because it covers a wide age range, it is useful in societies and parks where toddlers and older siblings play side by side. Send us your site size and photos to get started.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.name: Roto Wheel Go Round Merry-Go-Round

/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: Deluxe Junior See Saw is a two-seat see saw with Knight Blue seats, made for children aged 3 and above and mainly for 3 to 9 year olds. Two children sit facing each other and take turns pushing off the ground, which teaches cooperation and timing. It measures 7' x 2'3" and needs a safe play area of 11' x 6'3". As a first piece for a new play area in a school or society, it is hard to go wrong with. Ask us for a layout drawing that shows it with your other equipment.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.name: Deluxe Junior See Saw

/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: Deluxe Multi See Saw has four blue seats, so four children can ride together. Its key users are children aged 3 to 9, and it is suitable from age 3. The see saw measures 9'8" x 2'3", with a safe play area of 13'8" x 6'3". With twice the seats of a two-seat see saw, it helps schools and societies keep queues short at break time and in the evening rush. The colour is Knight Blue. We dispatch it by road from our Vasai factory, and our team or a local dealer installs it. Call us for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.name: Deluxe Multi See Saw

/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: Double See Saw is a cross-shaped see saw with four Knight Blue seats, so two pairs can play at once. It is suitable from age 3, and the main users are 3 to 9 year olds. The product area is 8'2" x 6'9", and the safe play area is 12'2" x 10'9". Its cross layout is shorter than our in-line four-seater, which helps on square plots and in courtyards. Schools, play schools and society parks can use it to give four children a turn together. Send us your site size and we will check the fit.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.name: Double See Saw

/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: Horse See Saw is a two-seat see saw with horse-shaped seats, in Knight Blue and Play Orange. It is meant for younger children, aged 3 and above, with 3 to 6 year olds as the main group. The see saw measures 7' x 2'3" and needs a safe play area of 11' x 6'3". The horse seats give little riders a shape they recognise, which helps shy children try it. It suits nursery schools, play schools and the toddler corner of a society garden. Ask us to include it in your playground proposal.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.name: Horse See Saw

/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: Rainbow See Saw is an arched see saw shaped like a rainbow, with two Knight Blue seats. It is for children aged 3 and up, and works best for the 3 to 6 group. At 6'4" x 1'7", with a safe play area of 10'4" x 5'7", it is narrow enough to fit into a small play area or along one side of a garden. The arch adds colour and shape to a themed playground for a preschool or a residential project. Call +91 902 830 2266 for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.name: Rainbow See Saw
